name: Can I finance an off-market waterfront home purchase?

mainEntity.name: Can I finance an off-market waterfront home purchase?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, financing an off-market waterfront home is generally possible, similar to a traditional sale. However, lenders will still require an appraisal to determine the property's market value, which can sometimes be more challenging for unique off-market properties with limited comparable sales data. Having a pre-approval or proof of funds is crucial, especially in competitive markets like Miami and Fort Lauderdale, to demonstrate your readiness and secure the property effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, financing is possible, but lenders require an appraisal which can be complex for off-market properties. Pre-approval or proof of funds is essential.
